name: Open on this task
title: Open on this task: the open items in a task's Where this stands listed on its page, each closed with Done, kept and labelled in its notes
aliases: what is still open on this task

events.done: You pressed Done on an open item in a task's Open on this task

permissions: reads the Where this stands of the task's notes (AGENTS.md)
strikes an item you mark done through in those notes and labels it, and puts it back on Undo
saves that change to your workspace like every change Rouh makes there
touches.remove: Turn the switch open_items off on its row in Evolution, Mutations, and the section is gone from task pages; to remove it for good revert night 28's commit (rouh/open_items.py, rouh/web/open_items.py, its route in rouh/project/urls.py, its lines in rouh/objectindex.py, the open_item act in cards.js, the tkOpen code in taskpage.js, the .oopen rules in taskbrowser.css, this manifest). rouh/not_handed.py reads its open items too.
